tasks.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the perimeter of this existing transparent game obstacle sprite. Preserve the exact canvas aspect ratio, original core position, core size IN PIXELS, all interior object sizes, arrangement, orientation and camera. Remove the continuous dark purple outer contour completely. Replace the abrupt soil cut edge with a narrow irregular hand-painted transition: sparse stones, dusty brush marks and moss/root tips that gradually become partially transparent and then fully transparent. Transition width about 0.35 world units on a 13.989 by 4.665 world-unit footprint, never a broad halo. Preserve every concavity and the overall original unique footprint. Leave generous transparent margins, no clipping. Preserve paving, puddles, stone sizes and moss. Matte stylized storybook game art, retain the reference rendering. Output one sprite with TRUE transparent alpha and partly transparent boundary pixels. No outline ring, platform, frame, background, text, colour fringe or fog halo.
